posts.title: Fixes from your first feedback
posts.summary: Your binder now shows only your cards, updating lots of cards is much faster, you can reset a collection, and the KPop Secret Pull answers who's on a card correctly.
posts.body:
## You asked, we built
- **Your binder only shows your cards.** Some of you saw cards in your binder that you never added, and couldn't take them out. Those were other collectors' public cards showing up by mistake. Your binder now loads only your own cards. Nobody's collection was changed, and private collections were never shown.
- **No more freezing when you update lots of cards.** Tapping + or − now updates that card straight away, and the rest of the page catches up when you stop. It's about 12 times faster on phones.
- **Reset my collection.** Want a fresh start? Tap **Reset collection** above the cards on any collection page, or find it in the menu. You can reset one collection or everything, and you'll be asked to type RESET first so it can't happen by accident.

A big thank you to **u/huntersvoices_strong** on Reddit for trying the site and telling us what went wrong. These fixes are thanks to you!

## Fixed
- **KPop Guess the Secret Pull** now knows who's on every card. Some scene and screenshot cards were missing their characters, so asking about HUNTR/X could get the wrong answer.

## Improved
- **Simpler KPop questions:** "Who's on it?" is now HUNTR/X, Saja Boys or Other.
- Scene, screenshot and album cards now count toward your favorite character's progress and badges like HUNTR/X Forever.

## Behind the scenes
- We went through all 95 KPop cards that didn't name a character, one by one, to list who's on each.

posts.title: Profiles for every collection, and 100+ new badges
posts.summary: Your profile now has a showcase and a favorite character for each collection you own, and badges cover every set, series and rarity.
posts.body:
## New
- **A favorite character for each collection.** Pick one for Winx Club and one for KPop Demon Hunters. Each one gets its own spot on your profile, with a progress bar in their colour and the cards of theirs you own.
- **A showcase for each collection.** Show off up to 5 cards from each collection you collect, and drag them into the order you like.
- **Over 100 new badges.** Rarity sets for every series (Fairy Diary, Costume Party, KPop Series 1, Special Mini and Series 2), edition badges, KPop badges like HUNTR/X Forever and Saja Boys Stan, merch badges and more.
- **Bigger Shimmer rewards.** Harder sets pay more: the rarer the cards and the bigger the set, the more Shimmer you get. Everyone who already earned a badge was topped up to the new amounts.

## Improved
- **Edit profile is tidier.** Each part folds up, and your chosen showcase cards sit in a box at the top, so you can see how they'll look, rearrange them and take one out without searching your whole binder.
- **The Badges page folds up too.** Hide the categories you don't need, or jump straight to one from the bar at the top. It also shows how close you are to each badge.
- **Easier to read at night.** When the KPop background turns to night, panels and badges keep their normal text.

## Behind the scenes
- Every KPop Demon Hunters Series 2 card number was checked against the printed cards before we took the "not confirmed" labels off.
- Badge rewards are worked out card by card, so a 20-card Titan Rare set pays more than an 8-card one.

posts.title: KPop Demon Hunters games, real card pictures and card shine
posts.summary: Play Guess the Secret Pull and Daily Trivia with KPop Demon Hunters cards, and see every KPop card with its real picture and foil.
posts.body:
## New
- **KPop Demon Hunters games.** Guess the Secret Pull and Daily Trivia now come in a Winx Club and a KPop Demon Hunters version. Sparkles from both go into the same total and the same leaderboard.
- **Real pictures for every KPop card.** All 389 cards from Series 1, the Special Mini Edition and Series 2 now show their real picture.
- **Card shine.** Cards shimmer the way they do in your hand: foil, holo, glitter and shine are matched to each rarity, card by card.
- **Serial numbers.** Serialized cards (like Scenario-E and Brush Rare) get a box to write the number printed on your copy.

## Behind the scenes
- The KPop Demon Hunters background went through a lot of demon-marking designs that didn't make the cut. It ended up as a pastel stage with moving rainbow lines that fades into a sparkly night every so often.
- The Laser Tickets were matched style by style: 8 Regular, 8 Special, 2 secret Saja Boys and 2 super secret HUNTR/X.

posts.title: KPop Demon Hunters has arrived
posts.summary: Track every KAYOU KPop Demon Hunters card and piece of merch, plus the new Winx Club Costume Party set.
posts.body:
## New
- **A KPop Demon Hunters collection.** Every KAYOU KPop Demon Hunters card: Classic and Energy Editions for Series 1 and 2, the Special Mini Edition and promos.
- **Merch tracking.** Albums, card holders, Laser Tickets and the Costco Collector Boxes can be added to your collection style by style, just like cards.
- **A products guide on each collection page.** Tap any KAYOU product to see what's in it, with a link to KAYOU's page.
- **Winx Club Costume Party.** The new mini set is ready to track: 45 cards in 8 rarities plus 3 promos.
- **Trade lists.** Make a list of the cards you need and your extras to share with other collectors.

## Improved
- **Search by group**, like Winx, Specialists, Trix, Pixie Pets, HUNTR/X or Saja Boys.
- **Hide and show** any edition or rarity in your binder, and the site remembers what you hid.

## Behind the scenes
- Every product photo comes from KAYOU, and the merch styles are kept in a master list so the site matches what's really in the boxes.

posts.title: Daily games, badges and Sparkles
posts.summary: Play Guess the Secret Pull and Daily Trivia every day, earn Sparkles and badges, and climb the leaderboard.
posts.body:
## New
- **Guess the Secret Pull.** A new mystery card every day. Ask questions to narrow down your binder, watch the card get clearer, and guess it in 8 tries.
- **Daily Trivia.** 5 questions a day about the show and the cards.
- **A leaderboard** for the Sparkles you win playing.
- **Badges.** Earn them for collecting (like finishing a rarity set or half a collection), for the daily games, and for following My Pretty Pulls.
- **Two kinds of rewards.** Sparkles come from playing and are what you'll spend in the Sparkle Store. Shimmer comes from collection badges and is for fun extras on your profile.
- **Badges on your profile**, plus how long you've been collecting.
- **The Badges & Sparkles page** lists every badge and how to earn it.

## Behind the scenes
- Collection badges follow your binder: if you take cards out and no longer qualify, the badge goes away until you earn it back. That keeps the badges honest.

posts.title: Hello, My Pretty Pulls
posts.summary: The first version of My Pretty Pulls: a home for your Winx Club Fairy Diary collection.
posts.body:
## New
- **Every Winx Club Fairy Diary card**, Daily and Magic Editions plus promos, with your progress by edition, rarity and character.
- **Accounts** so your collection is saved on every device.
- **Profiles** you can share with a link or as an image.

## Behind the scenes
- My Pretty Pulls started as one collector's spreadsheet of Winx cards. It's made by a collector, for collectors.
